name: How long does it take to replace broken window glass?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace broken window glass?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for broken window glass replacement varies depending on the type of window, the glass availability, and the extent of the damage. Simple single-pane replacements can often be completed within a few hours once the glass is on site. For custom-sized or specialized glass, such as tempered or insulated units, there may be a lead time for manufacturing. Our team aims to secure the opening quickly, often with temporary boarding, and then proceed with the full replacement as efficiently as possible.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most replacements take a few hours once glass is available; custom glass may have lead times for manufacturing.
